purpose: Help readers find direct title matches and search localized text while handling async loading and IME input.
publication: Draft only; user approved PR74 publication, not this follow-up.

scope.ranking: All query terms required; exact title/phrase then per-term title/topic/description/body weights; ties retain original index order.
scope.normalization: NFKC and lowercase; decompose/strip marks only for Latin characters. Preserve kana voicing and distinct Cyrillic letters.

review.type: Self AI code/UI/translation review; not an independent or human review

findings.issue: The original substring filter returned corpus order, so body mentions could precede a title match.
findings.resolution: Normalize once per index load and rank all matched entries before applying the display limit.

findings.issue: Removing every Unicode mark would merge distinct Japanese and Cyrillic letters.
findings.resolution: Limit accent folding to Latin letters and test preserved distinctions plus Hangul canonical composition.

findings.issue: A rejected shared promise after clearing could poison the next input.
findings.resolution: Reset the failed index promise in its own rejection handler, independently of whether its UI version is stale.

findings.issue: Slow responses and composition input could repaint obsolete results.
findings.resolution: Version the request/render cycle; ignore composition input until commit and keep latest/cleared input authoritative.

findings.issue: A bare displayed count hid the existence of results after the 50-item cap.
findings.resolution: Localize displayed and total counts separately; preserve no-results and error states.

findings.issue: Technical titles may contain HTML-looking text.
findings.resolution: Continue rendering title/description through textContent; test no inserted image or event execution.

translationReview.method: Meaning comparison followed by a standalone fluency pass; count-label wording avoids numeric noun inflection. Placeholders retained exactly. Limited to these short UI strings.

browser.case: latest query wins over a delayed shared request
HTTP failure, keyboard retry, 61 total / 50 shown, safe literal text
failure after clear recovers on the next query

validation.generatedSearchPages: All eight search pages remain noindex, outside sitemap, with hidden retry and static noscript browse guidance.

limits: This improves internal site search; external ranking and user engagement effects were not measured.
Accented Latin spellings can share a match; this is not transliteration or semantic search.
IME checks use synthetic composition events, not every native OS keyboard.
Normalization does not certify article translation quality.
Existing article order is retained only for equal scores; no new recency signal is invented.
